test_title: PYST 4: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Here some problem or solution of the problem is given in the statement you have to choose the appropriate logical deduction for given statement.

Technologist: "Automation will not replace humans, but redefine the nature of work, requiring adaptation rather than fear."

Which of the following, if true, best supports the technologist's prediction?

options.text: AI has replaced workers in routine factory jobs across the world.
Companies are retraining employees to work with AI-based tools.
Many people fear that machines will make them jobless.
Automation has led to increased productivity in manufacturing.

solution:
Given statement: Technologist: "Automation will not replace humans, but redefine the nature of work, requiring adaptation rather than fear."

Logical deduction:

The statement suggests that automation will change the type of work people do, and humans will need to adapt by learning new skills instead of fearing job loss.

Option I </str
